CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to the identified content is present.

COD.rationale: Content (red attribute), an organization/access origin, and a separate status/origin field are explicitly present for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or content-processing condition is linked to the identified content's organization/access in the text.

C.rationale: Multiple lines explicitly identify named content items and attributes (e.g. red/blue) with coordinate values.

D.rationale: The report separately lists content identity (red coordinate) and the content's origin/status (history_estimate), distinguishing identity from status.

O.rationale: The text describes presentation properties (grid orientation) and representation/organization details (origin/represented_time) for identified contents.
